stemBlocks: Study the chromatogram below showing the spots obtained, labelled (i) to (v), from two sweets and pure samples of the food additives, labelled Q, R and S.
Which of the following statements about the chromatogram is/are correct?

1 Both sweet 1 and 2 contain additives R and S.
2 The $R_f$ value for spot (iv) is half that for spot (iii).
3 The $R_f$ value for spot (v) is 0.7.

assets.alt: Chromatogram showing spots (i) to (v) from two sweets and pure samples of food additives Q, R, and S, with a solvent front and baseline indicated.
